key_insight: Granger causality–informed DMD uses directional predictive dependencies to identify sparser flow models with improved prediction accuracy.
engineering_relevance: The framework could support more reliable reduced-order prediction of complex unsteady flows for engineering analysis.
method: Estimate conditional Granger causality from flow data.
Use these estimates to regularize DMD operator identification.
Suppress weakly supported interactions while retaining dynamically relevant couplings.
evidence_signal: Tests on a known linear system, lid-driven cavity flows, and a broadband transonic turbulent jet report gains over standard DMD in operator identification, spectral robustness, or prediction accuracy.
watch_item: Granger causality measures predictive dependence rather than physical causation, so inferred couplings require careful interpretation.
paper_title: Causality-informed dynamic mode decomposition for unsteady flow analysis
